Meanwhile the two men above you lose nothing if you go. What have you offered either of them for their vote?

delivered to Tovah as #227

The board now names the accused line and the price of a seat, and each of the four has been given their own stake in the 38 vote — Aurelio his 10-point margin, Juniper their last seat, Mercer his dead goal and one vote, Tovah his unclaimed 25 and the two men above him.
